paraphrase.proposes: The track pins earshot in a repository-local virtual environment and adds a wrapper that renders one named Chibi sound set into Ogg files. It commits seven generated sounds and adds tests for the wrapper's exact failure messages and the files' Ogg/Vorbis headers. Playback integration remains outside this track.
paraphrase.current_system: Games currently synthesize effects through AudioBus and do not load sound files. The audio library stores recorded MP3 takes and provides a review tool, but the game effects do not use those files. A separate integration track owns playback wiring, browser formats, and credits.
